name: Dollville
source:
One day, Jack moves into the mansion as an assistant to a private doctor. There, he makes friends with a sick girl who spends almost all her time in bed. Nothing darkens Jack's newfound idyll, until one day he notices that the girl's left hand has become doll-like.

Made for /ruvn/ contest #6.
